about: The voiceover, one line per scene (the dashboard's lines follow its beats). record.mjs makes each scene as long as its lines need, so nothing is frozen. Changing a line's text costs ElevenLabs credits for that line and its neighbours (their intonation depends on it); everything else comes from the cache.

lines.text: This is Continuum. Claude Code starts a task, Codex finishes it, and nothing is lost in between.
First, connect both agents to your repository. One command each.
Claude Code fixes the first bug, records the task and its next step, and stops.
When Codex starts, Continuum briefs it automatically: what's done, what's left, and exactly what to do next.
Codex picks up the same task and finishes it. Then you run the tests through Continuum, so the result is verified.
In the dashboard, it's one task, carried from one agent to the other.
This check is verified: Continuum ran npm test against the exact contents of every file.
Here are the acceptance criteria and steps, as the agents reported them.
And here is the change itself, covered by the passing check.
Every event is recorded in order: Claude Code's session, then Codex picking up the same task.
Install it with one command. It runs on your machine, and nothing leaves it.
